idea-plugin.name: SetterSmith
idea-plugin.description:
SetterSmith: Automate Your Setter Method Generation

SetterSmith is your go-to IntelliJ IDEA plugin for eliminating boilerplate code and streamlining your Java development workflow. With a single click, this intuitive tool scans your classes, identifies fields, and generates robust setter methods with all the necessary parameters to ensure consistency and precision.

Key Features:

  • Quick Generation: Automatically create setter methods for your class fields, drastically reducing the time spent on repetitive coding.
  • Customizable Templates: Tailor the generated setter methods to meet your project’s style and standards, ensuring seamless integration with your existing codebase.
  • Enhanced Code Consistency: Adhere to best practices with setter methods that are consistently structured and formatted, making your code cleaner and more maintainable.
  • Native IntelliJ IDEA Integration: Enjoy a smooth, integrated experience that leverages the power of IntelliJ IDEA’s interface, context menus, and shortcuts.

Whether you're refactoring legacy code or setting up new projects, SetterSmith frees your creativity to focus on solving unique challenges—leaving the mundane, repetitive tasks in the past. With SetterSmith, you can enhance your coding efficiency while keeping your code elegant and professional.

Dive in today and transform your development workflow with SetterSmith!
